summary: Lifecore Biomedical filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) disclosing that on November 4, 2026 the DOJ and FTC granted early termination of the HSR waiting period for its previously announced September 27, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger with Lifecore Inc. (Parent) and Hazel Merger Sub, Inc., under which Merger Sub merges into the company, leaving Lifecore a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent. This satisfies the antitrust condition; remaining conditions include stockholder adoption of the merger agreement at a special meeting. No price, premium, advisor or break fee is stated in the excerpt. Watch the special-meeting vote and any remaining regulatory or closing conditions.
